label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee/celebration for the mayor, planned for day 1 at 18:00 in the great hall, including eight lanterns and 200 fresh loaves placed on the hall tables; the mayor was to be lured there under the pretext of a lighting inspection. Innkeeper, freight, and builder knowingly helped the baker prepare it. The record shows the 200 loaves and lanterns completed and verified. The mayor was not told the true purpose in the records shown; he was told it was an inspection.
